name: hd_fs30_v2_pilot
notes: PILOT for hd_fs30_v2 (~2 GPU-hours, docs/FS_PILOT.md). Same model, init (z ~ U(-4,4), seed 31, nothing from other runs), diagonal windowed adaptation, target_accept, tree depth and 8 vectorised chains as hd_fs30_v2; only the length differs, plus the opt-in exact FastPTALikelihood (likelihood_impl=fast) and a progress bar for monitoring. Sizing (measured before launch, RTX 5090): value+grad of the HD^free(30) potential, mixed-precision backward, B=8 vmapped = 159.5 ms per call (19.9 ms per chain; production 166.2 ms), so one 8-chain leapfrog step ~0.16 s; with lockstep tree lengths ~255-400 steps per iteration (curn_fs30: 213 mean / 267 lockstep-max of 4 chains per draw, 259 per warmup iteration) this is ~40-65 s per iteration, i.e. ~110-180 iterations in 2 h. 300 warmup + 250 draws would take ~6-8 h. numpyro schedule for 100 warmup: 15 initial buffer, one 75-iteration metric window, 10 terminal. Abort rule (fixed before launch): stop if warmup alone projects > 1.75 h; after warmup, stop at the last 25-draw checkpoint that ends before 2.5 h total wall time. Not a reproduction run: the freespec gate is expected to fail at this length.
